![Artwork by [Allison Horst](https://allisonhorst.github.io/palmerpenguins/)](images/lter_penguins.png){width=50% fig-alt="Illustration of the three penguin species: Chinstrap, Gentoo, and Adelie"}

This dashboard showcases how [Quarto](https://quarto.org) can integrate **multiple visualization technologies** into a cohesive, static-site dashboard. 

**No server required.**

Each page showcases different technologies:

- **[Species Overview](species.qmd)** — Boxplots of body measurements using {echarts4r} and page headers
- **[Island Comparison](islands.qmd)** — Scatter plots and composition charts using {echarts4r} and Quarto tabs
- **[Explorer](explorer.qmd)** — Interactive app usign shinylive
- **[D3 Visualization](penguins-d3.qmd)** — Interactive waffle chart using React + D3
- **[Data](data.qmd)** — Embedded data table using {reactable}
